Subject: Notice: downstream subcontractor added to data-pipeline service

Hi Soojin,

Quick heads up — as part of our Q3 rollout we are adding a new analytics partner (InsightStream LLC) that will ingest anonymized logs from the Data Processing route described in Appendix A of our Order Form. InsightStream will act as a subprocessor for the event analytics pipeline and will have transient access to aggregated telemetry only (no PII).

I've attached an updated subprocessor manifest (Pacifica_subproc_list_v2.pdf) and a short summary of their controls. Per our MSA Section 2.3 and the data processing schedule, we wanted to surface this change early and confirm your approval path.

Immediate asks from our side:
- Does Redwood need a DPA addendum or a simple change notice for this subcontracting addition?
- Do you require SOC 2 evidence or a completed subprocessor questionnaire before we proceed?
- Target go-live for the pipeline change: 2028-07-02. Can we lock an approval decision by 2028-06-20?

Thanks,
Ananya Shah
Head of Partnerships
Pacifica Cloud
[Attachment: Pacifica_subproc_list_v2.pdf (PDF, 126KB)]

Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Notice: downstream subcontractor added to data-pipeline service

Ananya — thanks for the heads up and the manifest. A few quick clarifications before I route this to Legal/Trust: 

1) Scope: please confirm that InsightStream will only receive aggregated non-PII telemetry and that no raw request bodies or user identifiers are shared.
2) Retention: what retention window will apply to the aggregated logs? (Redwood requires evidence < 90 days for analytics in our Order Forms.)
3) Controls: high level SOC 2 or ISO27001 statement and whether they have an MSA/contract with Pacifica that includes the DPA flowdown.

Assuming the answers are as above, we'll likely treat this as a subprocessor change notice with a short evidence check (SOC 2 report or completed questionnaire). I'm looping in Kimberly and Aditya from Legal/Procurement to confirm the approval path and timeline.

Can Kimberly/A ditya confirm by EOD whether we need a DPA amendment (signed addendum) vs. simple acknowledgement? If we need DocuSign it will add ~3-5 business days.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Director, Customer Success Operations

Soojin / Aditya — I reviewed the manifest and the short controls summary. Initial read: InsightStream is a standard analytics vendor (no raw PII) but there are two contract items to confirm before we mark as approved:

1) DPA flowdown language: Pacifica's manifest references a flowdown but we need to confirm their contract includes the express Data Processing Addendum (DPA) with the subprocessor flow-down clause that mirrors our MSA Section 4.2. If Pacifica simply lists InsightStream without contractual flowdown, we must obtain a signed addendum or an evidence package.

2) Order Form impact: The Order Form has a clause requiring notification for any subprocessor change that affects data residency/retention. If InsightStream will retain any telemetry >90 days, we must update the Order Form retention table and circulate an amendment.

Proposed path (fastest):
- Ask Pacifica for: (a) confirmation of contractual flowdown (signed DPA or a redline excerpt) and (b) SOC 2 Type II report or completed Redwood subprocessor questionnaire.
- If we receive both, Legal will sign an acknowledgement and we will record as approved. No Order Form change needed.
- If we do not receive contractual flowdown, request a DPA addendum via DocuSign (approx. 3-5 biz days).

Attachment: I've drafted a one-page checklist and a short redline for the Order Form retention appendix (Redlines_OrderForm_v3.docx) — see notes below.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Contracts
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redlines_OrderForm_v3.docx (DOCX, 42KB)]

Date: Wed, 13 Jun 2028 11:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Notice: downstream subcontractor added to data-pipeline service — next steps and timeline

Ananya — thanks, and appreciate the quick reply on the three items below (you provided details inline). Summary and next steps from Redwood: 

• Scope confirmed: InsightStream receives aggregated event metrics only; no PII or raw request bodies.
• Retention: Pacifica confirms a 45-day retention window for aggregated metrics (OK for our Order Form default).
• Controls: InsightStream provided a SOC 2 Type II snapshot and Pacifica sent a clause excerpt confirming contractual DPA flowdown to InsightStream.

Given the evidence, Legal (Kimberly) has approved proceeding under a change-notice path (no DPA amendment required). We will file the SOC 2 snapshot and questionnaire in our evidence store and record the change in the compliance ledger.

Action items and timeline:
- Pacifica: please upload the signed clause excerpt and the SOC 2 report to the shared drive link (https://drive.redwood.company/teams/legal/PAC-4892/subproc-evidence) by 2028-06-15.
- Redwood (Soojin): I will update our internal Order Form tracker and close the change notice once evidence is in place (target 2028-06-16).
- If anything changes (retention >90d or access to identifiers), we will require a formal Order Form amendment and DocuSign DPA addendum.

Thanks again — looking forward to the go-live on 2028-07-02.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Director, Customer Success Operations
Redwood Inference
